rows.label: tlk70000051_04_msg0001
rows.name:
You came by just to say
hi? You don't need to
worry about us, you know.

rows.label: tlk70000051_04_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm the leader of the Invidian
contingent here. I swear to uphold
that title, even when Adel isn't here.

rows.label: tlk70000051_04_msg0003
rows.name:
No matter what interference some big
shots from another country try, I'll
throw it right back at them.

rows.label: tlk70000051_04_msg0004
rows.name:
When you get back, we'll grab some
drinks and have a good old feast.

rows.label: tlk70000051_04_msg0005
rows.name:
I'll be waiting to hear your stories
when you get back.
